title: Coordinates for normalized rational scalar comparison
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraic closure k of a finite field and a coefficient datum C with prime ell different from char(k), a fixed algebraic closure of Q_ell, and its finite intermediate fields E. Let f : X → Y be smooth separated of pure relative dimension d ≥ 0 between separated finite-type k-schemes. Let S be a constructible exceptional coefficient system and I its supplied simultaneous integral purity data [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality]. Use the finite-Tor integral categories and raw rational categories, rational pullback/tensor and Tate lines of [def-pur-conventions], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports]. Define Q as the recorded rationalization, H as rational pullback tensored with the shifted Tate line, G as the right adjoint of S, T as strict rational scalar extension, b and c as the right and left comparisons of S, and alpha and unit as its published scalar tensor associator and unitor. Retain the recorded integer shifts. LocalizesComparison is the component equation through four localization identifications; PuritySquares records the forward and inverse squares; UnitEquation and CompositionEquation are the usual tensor coherence equations. SourceLocalizationNormalization fixes the source comparison on every good pullback representative by the twist-to-single-line complex isomorphism, first-factor shift, tensor augmentation, completed-tensor comparison and literal rational pullback/tensor object identifications. It includes goodness of the shifted line.
